instruction: Help me to download and install Numix theme from gnome-look.org, then activate it on my GNOME desktop.

metadata.explanation: Task requires installing Numix theme from gnome-look.org and applying it to GNOME desktop. Evaluator checks if gtk-theme setting contains 'Numix' using gsettings command. Similar to original task but with different theme name.

llm_judge_reasons: Incomplete coverage: Instruction requires download from gnome-look.org, installation, AND activation, but evaluator only checks activation
Missing verification: Does not check if theme was actually downloaded from gnome-look.org (could be from apt/package manager)
Missing verification: Does not check if theme files exist in theme directories (e.g., ~/.themes/ or /usr/share/themes/)
Agent could cheat by only running 'gsettings set' command without actually installing the theme
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Add postconfig to check if theme files exist in expected directories: ~/.themes/Numix/ or /usr/share/themes/Numix/
Add verification to check theme directory structure contains required files (index.theme, gtk-3.0/, etc.)
Consider checking browser history or download folder for gnome-look.org visit/download (though this may be fragile)
Alternative: Simplify instruction to only require 'activate Numix theme' if full verification is not feasible
